articles.summary: (NYSE: AEM) (TSX: AEM) ("Agnico Eagle") announced today that it has entered into a subscription agreement dated August 24, 2026 (the "Subscription Agreement") with Radisson Mining Resources Inc. (TSX-V: RDS) ("Radisson"), pursuant to which Agnico Eagle agreed to acquire, in a non-brokered private placement, 53,420,000 units ("Units") of Radisson at a price of C$1.07 per Unit for total consideration of C$57,159,400 (the "Private Placement").
